methods.documented_intro: The method allows you to create a new inventory transfer in draft status. Both source and target warehouses must belong to inventories with advanced WMS enabled.

parameters.name: target_warehouse_id
parameters.documented_description: Target warehouse identifier. Can be the same as source warehouse for intra-warehouse location transfers.

parameters.name: transfer_type
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Transfer type: 0 - replenishment (default), 1 - putaway transfer, 2 - location change

parameters.name: date_due
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Due date (unix timestamp). Must be later than or equal to date_scheduled.

methods.documented_intro: The method allows you to add planning items to an inventory transfer in draft status. Entering the product with the ID updates the previously saved position only if all other parameters match. If any parameter differs (e.g. location), a new item will be added.

parameters.name: items
parameters.documented_description: List of items to add to the transfer

parameters.name: items[].quantity
parameters.documented_description: Quantity to transfer. Must be a positive integer.

parameters.name: items[].location_name
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Source WMS stock unit location. Must match an existing stock unit.

parameters.name: items[].expiry_date
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format (ISO 8601). Used for WMS unit matching.

parameters.name: items[].batch
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Batch number. Used for WMS unit matching.

parameters.name: items[].serial_no
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Serial number. Used for WMS unit matching.

fields.documented_description: SUCCESS - request executed correctlyERROR - an error occurred during an API request. Error details will be described in 2 additional returned fields: error_message and error_code

methods.documented_intro: The method allows you to retrieve a list of inventory transfers from BaseLinker storage. It supports pagination and optional filtering by status, warehouse, date range, and transfer type.

parameters.name: filter_transfer_id
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Filter by a specific transfer ID

parameters.name: filter_transfer_status
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Filter by transfer status: 0 - draft, 1 - commissioned, 2 - in progress, 3 - completed

parameters.name: filter_transfer_type
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Filter by transfer type: 0 - replenishment, 1 - putaway transfer, 2 - location change

parameters.name: page
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Results page number (100 transfers per page, numbered from 1)

methods.documented_intro: The method allows you to change the status of an inventory transfer. When completing it, unverified items omitted from completed_items are marked as missing goods.

parameters.name: status
parameters.documented_description: Target transfer status: 0 - draft, 1 - commissioned, 2 - in progress, 3 - completed.

parameters.name: completed_items
parameters.documented_description: (optional) List of transferred items. Unlisted unverified items are marked as missing goods.

parameters.name: completed_items[].completed_quantity
parameters.documented_description: Quantity transferred to the target location

fields.documented_description: SUCCESS - request executed correctlyERROR - an error occurred during an API request. Error details will be described in 2 additional returned fields: error_message and error_code
